hero.tagline: Your questions, our facts. Clear answers about our products, materials and documents.
hero.intro: Here you find clear answers to the questions our partners and their customers ask most often. Every claim in this FAQ is specific and backed by evidence: an independent laboratory test, patents and documents from our manufacturer.

items.question: Who is ëkcos?

answer.text: ëkcos innovations develops, manufactures and distributes fragranced urinal screens, toilet bowl clips and air fresheners. We are the market leader in the United States and have introduced our products in more than 70 countries. Our products are made in Mexico. Our central warehouse in the Czech Republic supplies customers and partners across Europe, Asia and Africa.

items.question: What makes ëkcos products different?

answer.text: Four things:

items: Splash protection. Our patented anti-splash bristles (Sealed Bristles Technology™) cover up to 95% of the screen.
Long fragrance life. ëkcoscreen 60+ and xcrën HD 60+ give 60+ days of fragrance, twice as long as standard 30-day screens.
Material facts you can check. Made with recycled EVA. Biodegradable in landfill with the Eco-One™ additive, as an independent laboratory test shows.
Your brand on the product. Your logo can be cut into the screen itself.

items.question: Which urinal screen should I choose?

answer.text: Choose by traffic and by how often the restroom is serviced.

Keeping solids and debris out of the drain. Deodorizing puck.

items.question: How long does a urinal screen last?

answer.text: ëkcoscreen 60+ and xcrën HD 60+ give 60+ days of fragrance, twice as long as standard 30-day screens. In low-traffic restrooms they last even longer. powër screen, üro lite, basic scrëen and xcrën puck give up to 30 days, which makes them ideal for monthly maintenance.

items.question: Why choose a 60+ day screen?

answer.text: ëkcoscreen 60+ lasts twice as long as a standard 30-day screen at a similar cost per day. You also replace it half as often, so your staff spend less time on it.

items.question: How does the anti-splash system work?

answer.text: Our screens use Sealed Bristles Technology™, our own patented anti-splash system. Dense bristles break up the urine stream and minimize urine splashback. The bristles cover 95% of ëkcoscreen 60+ and 92% of xcrën HD 60+. üro lite uses the same technology with long bristles, which give big splash protection in a small screen.

items.question: Is there proof that the bristles work?

answer.text: We filmed ëkcoscreen 60+ in a side-by-side UV splash test under identical conditions: the same urinal model, the same height and the same flow. ëkcoscreen 60+ showed no visible splashback outside the screen. Ask us for the video. The bristle system itself is patented.

items.question: Can I use the screens in waterless urinals?

answer.text: Yes. ëkcoscreen 60+ and xcrën HD 60+ are ideal for waterless urinals, and powër screen, üro lite and basic scrëen are suitable too. For the drain of a waterless urinal, see ëz trap below.

items.question: Will the screen fit my urinal?

answer.text: powër screen and basic scrëen have a flexible shape that fits almost all urinal types, and üro lite is made for smaller urinals. You find the size of each screen in the table above.

items.question: How do I place or change a urinal screen?

answer.text: Wear gloves. Take out the used screen and put it in general waste. Unpack the new screen and lay it flat in the bottom of the urinal, over the drain, with the bristles facing up. Replace it when the fragrance fades or at your usual service interval.

items.question: How do I dispose of a used screen?

answer.text: Put it in general waste. The EVA material itself can be recycled, but a used urinal screen cannot, because it is biologically contaminated. It ends up in landfill or incineration. That is why we add the Eco-One™ additive, which makes our material biodegradable in landfill.

items.question: What is xcrën puck?

answer.text: xcrën puck is an X-shaped urinal screen with a deodorizing puck. The X shape stops solids and debris from clogging the drain, and the puck releases a fresh fragrance with each use for up to 30 days. The puck is made mainly from wax and glycerin and dissolves with use. It cannot be replaced, so you change the whole xcrën puck.

items.question: What does NON-PARA mean?

answer.text: It means that the puck in xcrën puck contains no paradichlorobenzene (PARA), which the WHO classifies as possibly carcinogenic. ëkcos has never used PARA. NON-PARA does not mean paraben-free.

items.question: What is ëz trap, and which urinals does it fit?

answer.text: ëz trap is a cartridge for waterless urinals. Urine flows through the siphon, and a closing cap seals after each use, which helps keep drain odors from escaping. It fits Sloan, Falcon, Vitra, Bobrick and other brands that use the Falcon Velocity system (diameter 11.8 cm, height 11.5 cm).

items.question: How long does ëz trap last, and how do I maintain it?

answer.text: The cartridge lasts 4 to 6+ months and needs no costly gels or special cleaners. Pour a glass of water into the urinal every day to prevent calcium buildup. Regular cleaning with an anti-calcium agent, such as a quality toilet gel, extends its life. ëz trap comes with or without the removal tool. The tool is reusable, so you only need it with your first order.

items.question: What is ëkco mat?

answer.text: ëkco mat is an absorbent, disposable floor mat for the area under the urinal. At 54 x 51 cm it covers the area around most standard urinals. It protects the floor from urine and reduces the urine carried away on shoe soles.

categories.title: Air fresheners and toilet bowl clips

items.question: Which air freshener should I choose?

items: frësh drop: for toilet cubicles and restrooms. 30+ days of fragrance in cubicles with little ventilation and 60+ days at low traffic, with no batteries or electricity.
ëkco clip: clips onto the toilet bowl and gives up to 30 days of fragrance. Its flexible shape fits almost all bowl types.
ëkco loop: compact freshener for small spaces with little airflow, such as under desks, inside trash bin lids, closets and shoe cabinets. Up to 30 days. For toilet cubicles, choose frësh drop.

items.question: How long does frësh drop last?

answer.text: In cubicles with little or no ventilation it lasts 30+ days, and at low traffic 60+ days. When the fragrance fades, you replace only the insert. The base stays on the wall.

items.question: How do I install frësh drop and ëkco loop?

answer.text: Both are systems of a base and a fragrance insert. Fix the base on a clean, dry surface: frësh drop with the included adhesive tape, ëkco loop with its adhesive mounting base. Then attach the insert. On frësh drop, a small twist lock holds the insert on the base, and spare locks are available if one gets lost. Place ëkco loop close to where you want the fragrance.

items.question: How is the fragrance released?

answer.text: Passively. The fragrance is infused into the material and released gradually over time. No sprays, batteries or electricity are needed.

items.question: Which colors and fragrances are available?

answer.text: Our main lines share the same eleven colors and fragrances: purple / berry, green / apple, blue / fresh, orange / tropical fruit, clear / tropical fruit, black / mint, flame / mango, green / pine, red / melon, purple / lavender and yellow / citrus. So a building can keep one scent from the urinal to the cubicle. Our scents are easy to recognize: apple smells like apple, melon like melon.

items.question: What should I know about safe handling?

answer.text: Some of our fragranced products may cause an allergic skin reaction. Please follow the label and the safety data sheet, wear gloves when you handle the products, and keep them out of the reach of children.

items.question: What are ëkcos products made of?

answer.text: Our urinal screens, toilet bowl clips and air freshener inserts are made from a proprietary material infused with a deodorant-based fragrance. The material is made with recycled EVA. The share of recycled EVA varies from batch to batch, so we do not state a fixed percentage. Every ëkcos product except ëkco mat contains the Eco-One™ additive.

items.question: What is Eco-One™?

answer.text: Eco-One™ is an organic additive made by EcoLogic, LLC. We add about 1% of it to our material during production. It does not change the product’s strength, appearance or performance. When the product ends up in a biologically active landfill, the material breaks down into biogas, CO₂ and humus. Modern landfills use the biogas for energy.

items.question: What does “biodegradable in landfill” mean, and how was it tested?

answer.text: It means that our material breaks down in a biologically active landfill, where used screens end up. The Instituto Politécnico Nacional in Mexico City tested ëkcos EVA with Eco-One™ under the standards ASTM D5511 and ISO 15985. It reached 93% biodegradation within 3.5 years, while the same material without the additive showed 0%. Up to 99% is projected within 5 years. This is a projection from the measured trend, not a measured result. Biodegradation depends on landfill conditions.

items.question: Why don’t you call your products “eco-friendly”?

answer.text: Since 27 September 2026, EU rules (Directive (EU) 2024/825) no longer allow general claims such as “eco-friendly”, “green” or “sustainable” without recognized proof of excellent environmental performance. So we tell you exactly what we can prove: made with recycled EVA, biodegradable in landfill with Eco-One™ in an independent laboratory test, and boxes made from 100% recycled cardboard.

items.question: Can ëkcos products be recycled?

answer.text: The EVA material itself can be recycled. A used urinal screen or toilet bowl clip cannot, because it is biologically contaminated, so it belongs in general waste. The inserts of frësh drop and ëkco loop are made with recycled EVA and are not contaminated, so their material can be recycled. Please follow your local waste rules. We do not call our products “100% recyclable”, because that would not be true for a used screen.

items.question: What packaging do you use?

answer.text: Our product boxes and master cases are made from 100% recycled corrugated cardboard. The product bags are made of BOPP, a polypropylene film. We make no environmental claim about the bags. Packaging documentation under the EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR) is available for your compliance files.

items.question: Can I get products with my own logo?

answer.text: Yes. We can cut your logo into the screen itself, not only print it on the packaging, so it stays there for the life of the product. Your logo can also be printed on the product. The packaging can carry your own labels with your logo and EAN codes, and you choose the colors and fragrances.

items.question: Which products can carry my logo?

answer.text: Most of our products. Urinal screens and ëkco clip can carry your logo cut into the material or printed. frësh drop is branded by printing. ëkco loop has no space for a logo.

items.question: What are the conditions for private label?

answer.text: Minimum quantities depend on the product, and there is a one-time setup fee per branded product. Branded products are made to order, with a typical production and delivery time of 6 to 10 weeks. Custom orders are paid 100% in advance. Ask us for an offer.

items.question: How fast do you ship partner orders?

answer.text: We dispatch partner orders within 3 to 5 working days. If a product is temporarily out of stock, we usually ship it within a month, because new goods arrive at our warehouse from Mexico regularly.

items.question: How do you ship, and how long does delivery take?

answer.text: Within the Czech Republic we ship parcels and pallets with FOFR. To other EU countries we ship parcels with FedEx and pallets with DSV. Delivery within the EU usually takes about 5 days after dispatch, and less for countries close to the Czech Republic, for example 1 to 2 days to Germany and Austria and 3 to 4 days to Italy, France and the Netherlands. Outside the EU we quote transport for each order, and many partners arrange their own transport. We calculate transport costs for each order.

items.question: Can I get samples?

answer.text: Yes. Ask us for samples, so you and your customers can compare our products and fragrances with those of any other supplier.

items.question: Which documents can I get from you?

items: Biodegradation test certificate from the Instituto Politécnico Nacional, Mexico City (ASTM D5511 and ISO 15985).
Eco-One™ leaflet that explains the additive and the test.
PPWR packaging documentation from our manufacturer, for your compliance files only. Please do not share the supplier declarations with anyone except the authorities.
Patents for Sealed Bristles Technology™ and our screen shapes.
Safety data sheets for our fragranced products.
UV splash test video of ëkcoscreen 60+.

items.question: What marketing support do you offer?

items: Professional product photos and videos, including the UV splash test.
Ready-to-use product texts in 22 languages.
Logos and brand visuals.
Comparison guide, Eco-One™ leaflet, test certificate, PPWR documentation and safety data sheets.

items.question: Why did your product texts change?

answer.text: Two new EU rules now apply to product information and packaging: Directive (EU) 2024/825 (new rules for environmental claims) since 27 September 2026, and the Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (EU) 2025/40 (PPWR) since 12 August 2026. We reviewed every claim against these rules. Our new texts contain only specific environmental claims backed by evidence. Please use them in your e-shop, catalogs and offers.

items.question: Which older statements should I remove?

items: General terms such as “eco-friendly”, “green”, “ecological” or “sustainable”, also for packaging.
“Cellophane bag” or “cellophane packaging”. Our bags are made of BOPP.
“100% recyclable”. Our new texts say exactly what can be recycled.
“99% biodegradable within 5 years” as a test result. The test measured 93% within 3.5 years. Up to 99% within 5 years is a projection.
“Biodegradable” on its own in product names or titles. Please write “biodegradable in landfill”.
Any statement about bacteria, viruses, germs or health protection.
VOC and toxicity statements such as “complies with European VOC standards”, “No VOC” or “non-toxic to the environment”.
Absolute promises such as “eliminates splashback” or “odor-free”.
“Paraben-free” for NON-PARA. NON-PARA means that the puck contains no paradichlorobenzene.
“60+ days” on its own for frësh drop. Please write “30+ days in cubicles with little ventilation and 60+ days at low traffic”.

items.question: Can I edit or translate the product texts?

answer.text: Please use our approved texts, which are ready in 22 languages. If you shorten or adapt them, keep every condition that belongs to a claim, for example “in landfill”, “made with recycled EVA” and the difference between the measured 93% and the projected 99%.
